name: Eyebrow transplant

lead: An eyebrow transplant relocates individual hair follicles into the brow, to add density, fill gaps or reshape the brow. Surgeons describe the brow as small but demanding, because angle, direction, density and hair curliness must match the natural pattern.

Published reports are case series with satisfaction surveys and few complications. On looksmax.org, members mention eyebrow transplants when planning appearance changes, such as thicker or longer brows, alongside other surgeries.

paras: Follicular units are harvested, by follicular unit extraction, from the scalp or the area behind the ear and placed into small recipient sites angled to follow the brow. A long-hair extraction technique lets the surgeon see hair curl to match it. Periauricular (around-the-ear) hair has been used because it grows slowly and is fine, like brow hair.

Reported series describe few complications, but they are small and surgeon-authored. Mismatched curl, direction or density can produce unnatural results, and reviews describe corrective operations after unsatisfactory work.

lead: Eyebrow transplantation is a hair restoration procedure in which follicular units are moved into the eyebrow to increase density, fill sparse areas or reshape the brow [1][1]. Reviews describe it as having become popular, and follicular unit extraction (FUE) as the most popular technique [2].

A 2021 case series of 36 patients treated with the long hair follicular unit excision technique reported natural results and satisfaction, with patient and surgeon scores of 4.7 and 4.3 on a five-point scale; twelve patients had had unsatisfactory surgery elsewhere and four had touch-ups [3]. A 2024 retrospective study of 81 patients used periauricular hair and reported no significant complications over 15 months of follow-up [4].
Evidence is limited to such case series and expert reviews. No controlled trials of eyebrow transplantation were found.
infobox: Follicular unit extraction; long-hair FUE variant [3][5]
Mean 292 grafts for eyebrows in one series; about 402-482 follicular units in another [5][4]

paras: A 2017 review describes the eyebrow as a prominent feature that demands precision in anatomy, design, extraction and implantation, with follicular unit extraction the most popular technique [2]. The long hair FUE method allows surgeons to see hair curliness, which is described as crucial for matching eyebrow hair, and can camouflage the recipient area with long hair [3][5]. A study of 34 eyebrow cases within a series of 134 long hair FUE patients reported a mean of 292 grafts per eyebrow transplant [5].

A 2024 study used periauricular hair, which has a slow growth rate and fine caliber similar to eyebrow hair [4]. Training studies have tested silicone simulation models for learning eyebrow design and planting [6].

In the 36-patient series, all patients showed natural results at follow-up with no asymmetry or adverse events such as folliculitis [3]. In the periauricular series of 81 patients (72 women and 9 men), average surgery duration was about 194 minutes for women and 229 for men, and no significant complications were reported over 15 months [4]. The studies are retrospective or uncontrolled and authored by the performing surgeons.

Looksmax.org members discuss eyebrow transplants when estimating costs for combined procedures, with one poster asking for a rough price alongside rhinoplasty and jaw surgery and receiving the reply that a consultation is needed for an estimate [7]. Another thread lists eyebrow transplant among options to thicken or lengthen brows or change their tilt, alongside hairline and eye color changes [8].

No controlled trials were found. Published human data consist of a 36-patient long-hair FUE series, a 134-patient long-hair FUE series that included 34 eyebrow cases, and an 81-patient retrospective periauricular series, all reporting good outcomes without a comparison group [3][5][4]. A registered trial of FUE for alopecic scars is not specific to eyebrows [9].

lore.intro: Eyebrow transplants appear in forum discussion mainly as an option within larger plans for brow shape, thickness or tilt [7][8].

claims.claim: An eyebrow transplant can make brows thicker, longer or reshaped.
A transplant could be a lower-risk way to lower the brow than surgery or botulinum toxin.

timeline.event: Japanese surgeon Okuda describes small hair grafts used mainly for eyebrows and eyelashes, according to Wikipedia's account of hair transplantation [10].
A review summarizes grafting techniques for eyebrows, beard and sideburns [1].
Long hair FUE series on eyebrow transplantation is published [3].
